# Advanced Micro Devices (AMD) — company report

**Latest quarter first: Q2 FY2026 (ended 27 June 2026)**, filed 5 Aug 2026. Revenue was **$11.54bn, up 50.1% YoY** and 12.5% QoQ; gross margin 53.8%, operating margin 17.3%, net income **$2.30bn, up 163% YoY**. The filing attributes the margin jump partly to lapping prior-year MI308 export-control inventory charges and to Data Center mix. This is a sharp acceleration versus the FY2025 full year (+34% revenue, 10.7% operating margin) — the current run-rate is materially stronger than the last annual picture.

## What AMD sells
AMD designs CPUs (EPYC server, Ryzen PC), GPUs (Radeon gaming, Instinct data-centre accelerators), semi-custom chips (notably console SoCs) and adaptive/FPGA products (Xilinx). The Q2 FY2026 10-Q shows the growth engine clearly: **Data Center revenue of $6.7bn, +107% YoY** (segment operating income $2.1bn vs a prior-year loss), while **Gaming fell 31% to $779m** on lower semi-custom demand. The filing also flags forward-looking items on **Helios rack-scale platform shipments**, a ZT Group acquisition-related asset-transfer gain, and future data-centre lease commitments — AMD is moving up-stack into full AI systems. (A fuller business-section dossier was unavailable from the cache; segment narrative above is from the filed 10-Q text.)

## Annual trend (USD millions, fiscal years)

| FY end | Revenue | Gross profit | Op. income | Net income | FCF | Op. margin | FCF margin |
|---|---|---|---|---|---|---|---|
| 2025-12-27 | 34,639 | 17,152 | 3,694 | 4,335 | 6,735 | 10.7% | 19.4% |
| 2024-12-28 | 25,785 | 12,725 | 1,900 | 1,641 | 2,405 | 7.4% | 9.3% |
| 2023-12-30 | 22,680 | 10,460 | 401 | 854 | 1,121 | 1.8% | 4.9% |
| 2022-12-31 | 23,601 | 10,603 | 1,264 | 1,320 | 3,115 | 5.4% | 13.2% |
| 2021-12-25 | 16,434 | 7,929 | 3,648 | 3,162 | 3,220 | 22.2% | 19.6% |

## Quarterly momentum (USD millions)

| Quarter end | Revenue | Gross margin | Op. margin | Net income |
|---|---|---|---|---|
| 2026-06-27 | 11,536 | 53.8% | 17.3% | 2,297 |
| 2026-03-28 | 10,253 | 52.8% | 14.4% | 1,383 |
| 2025-12-27 | 10,270 | 54.3% | 17.1% | 1,511 |
| 2025-09-27 | 9,246 | 51.7% | 13.7% | 1,243 |

Note: Q2 FY2026 net income includes an **$853m tax benefit** from releasing uncertain tax positions after IRS reasonable-cause relief (April 2025) — a one-off flattering the 19.9% net margin.

## Balance sheet and cash flow
At FY2025 year-end: total assets $76.9bn, equity $63.0bn, cash $5.5bn, short-term debt $1.75bn and long-term debt $2.35bn as separately reported balance-sheet lines. Operating cash flow was $7.71bn (+154% YoY); capex $974m; FCF $6.74bn. Buybacks were $1.32bn; no dividend. R&D intensity is high at 23.4% of revenue ($8.1bn in FY2025) — the main reinvestment channel. The Q2 FY2026 10-Q also discloses **future investment commitments and commencement of future payments under data-centre leases**; these are commitments and lease obligations, not reported balance-sheet debt, and are not summed with it here.

## Risks (from the filed record)
- **Export controls**: the prior-year quarter carried MI308 inventory and related charges from US government export controls on AMD Instinct MI308 data-centre GPUs — the filing lists "the extent of impact of export restrictions imposed by the U.S. on our business" as a forward-looking risk.
- **Segment concentration of growth**: Gaming revenue fell 31% YoY in Q2 FY2026 on lower semi-custom demand; growth is increasingly dependent on Data Center.
- **One-off earnings quality**: the $853m tax benefit and the expected ZT Group asset-transfer gain both flatter reported net income.
- **Rising fixed commitments**: new data-centre lease payment commitments and investment obligations are disclosed alongside the AI ramp.
- A dedicated risk-factor dossier was not available from the cache; the above is drawn from the filed 10-Q narrative.

## Competitive position
Among 187 IT-sector peers, AMD ranks in the **92nd percentile for 5-year revenue CAGR (28.8% vs 9.4% median)**, 63rd percentile for net margin (12.5% vs 9.4%), but only 37th percentile for ROE (6.9% — depressed by the Xilinx-inflated equity base). Its P/E of **156x** sits at a ~294% premium to the sector median of 39.6x.

## Valuation — what's priced in
At the 2 Oct 2026 quote of **$633.91** (Yahoo Finance), market cap is **$1.03tn**, P/E 156x on FY2025 diluted EPS of $2.65, with a 52-week range of $188.22–$645.46. The reverse DCF solves an implied FCF growth of **~36%/yr** over ten years (10% discount rate). Scenario outcomes versus the current market cap: bear (22% growth) **-62.9%**, base (30%) **-34.5%**, bull (38%) **+13.7%**. Even the bull case anchored on AMD's 54%/yr 5-year FCF CAGR barely clears today's price — the market is paying for sustained data-centre acceleration well beyond the filed record.

**The read** — AMD has genuinely inflected: Data Center doubling YoY, gross margin back above 53%, and FCF at a record $6.7bn with modest reported debt. But the $1tn market cap already assumes roughly a decade of ~36% FCF growth, and Q2's headline net income was boosted by a one-off $853m tax benefit. The investment question is less about execution than about how long the AI accelerator ramp can outrun a valuation that leaves little room for the Gaming segment's 31% decline to spread.

SEC sources: [AMD 10-K filed 2026-02-04](https://www.sec.gov/Archives/edgar/data/2488/000000248826000018/0000002488-26-000018-index.htm); [AMD 10-K filed 2025-02-05](https://www.sec.gov/Archives/edgar/data/2488/000000248825000012/0000002488-25-000012-index.htm); [AMD 10-K filed 2024-01-31](https://www.sec.gov/Archives/edgar/data/2488/000000248824000012/0000002488-24-000012-index.htm); [AMD 10-Q filed 2026-08-05](https://www.sec.gov/Archives/edgar/data/2488/000000248826000123/0000002488-26-000123-index.htm); [AMD 10-Q filed 2026-05-06](https://www.sec.gov/Archives/edgar/data/2488/000000248826000076/0000002488-26-000076-index.htm); [AMD 10-Q filed 2025-11-05](https://www.sec.gov/Archives/edgar/data/2488/000000248825000166/0000002488-25-000166-index.htm); [AMD 10-K filed 2023-02-27](https://www.sec.gov/Archives/edgar/data/2488/000000248823000047/0000002488-23-000047-index.htm); [AMD 10-K filed 2026-02-04](https://www.sec.gov/Archives/edgar/data/2488/000000248826000018/amd-20251227.htm).
